title: Brendan Sorsby is applying for NFL Supplemental Draft. Will Roger Goodell, NFL welcome him?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brendan Sorsby is applying for NFL Supplemental Draft. Will Roger Goodell, NFL welcome him?
sources.description: "The college issue is about eligibility, the NCAA and enforcement," an exec told Yahoo Sports on Monday. "None of that comes into play in the NFL. ... If Roger rules you can't play, you can't play."
